column1: # Totals of a stream with the message that wasm/wasmplayer.cpp sends to the front end at its end, and the hints that the
# front end shows for it in the report of the last session (System information). Both sides read this file:
# FormatSessionReportMessage() in wasm/session_report.hpp (tests/native/session_report_test.cpp) writes the message, and
# parseSessionReport() and getSessionReportHints() in wasm/platform/diagnostics.js (tests/unit/diagnostics.test.js) read
# it, with the settings 'Reference frame invalidation' and 'Limit audio delay' off.
# Format, separated by tabs: name, duration in ms, codec, width, height, frame rate, bitrate in kbps, frames, frames lost
# on the network, frames dropped by the TV, video resets, recovery keyframes, FEC repairs, FEC failures, top of the WASM
# heap in MB, size of the WASM memory in MB, growth of the heap in MB, the best 30 s host frame rate in hundredths of
# FPS, the average host processing latency in tenths of a millisecond, the channels of the audio stream, the work of
# the audio thread in ms per second of audio over the stream and in its busiest 10 s window, the windows above the
# limit of an overload (wasm/audio_load.hpp), whether the host offered reference frame invalidation (1 or 0), the lowest
# 30 s host frame rate in hundredths of FPS of the windows that count (not the first of the stream, not a paused
# host), the number of these windows, how many of them were below 95 % of the stream rate, the average frame receive
# time over the stream and in its highest second in hundredths of a millisecond, the requests for an IDR frame that
# moonlight-common-c sent to the host and held while the IDR frame of an earlier one was on its way, how far the sound
# of the TV media player ran ahead of the clock of the TV in ms after the first minute, at the end and at the highest
# (all 0 when nothing was measured), its drift in ms per hour or null without one (wasm/audio_lead.hpp: less than
# 10 minutes of sound), the message, the hints (their keys, comma separated).
